Script by Guido Barsi
Art by Claudio Fontau

Zoe is a young woman of endless curiosity—radiantly beautiful, intelligent, and above all, gifted with an imagination so vast it often outpaces reality.

Guided by this inner world, she created a pillow that can shape her dreams before they begin.
Now, every night, Zoe drifts into the dreams she chooses, where she can explore her deepest desires, awaken her sensuality, and let her heart wander freely.

Some of those dreams she brings into the daylight… and some she keeps safely in the realm of night.
